candidates.title: Jul, jul, strålande jul
candidates.first_line: Jul, jul, strålande jul, glans över vita skogar,
candidates.notes: Evers born 12 May 1853, died 22 Oct 1919 (sv.wikipedia). Infobox publication year 1921 (sv.wikipedia; song is music by Gustaf Nordqvist, which does not matter). First line from sv.wikisource verse 1. The title is the first four words of the line, so alt_words is used.

candidates.title: Gläns över sjö och strand (Betlehems stjärna)
candidates.notes: Poem first printed in Rydberg's novel Vapensmeden, 1891 (sv.wikisource and sv.wikipedia). Rydberg's death year 1895 is taken from the sv.wikipedia page's category 'Avlidna 1895' (page fetched; the category was read, not the infobox). Alice Tegnér's 1893 setting is music only. The song is the Betlehems stjärna hymn, so it may also be listed in the hymns category; check for duplicates with the hymn agent. The original-poem text on sv.wikisource is the 1891 text.

candidates.title: Nu tändas tusen juleljus
candidates.notes: Köhler born 22 May 1858, died 2 Feb 1925 (sv.wikipedia). Diktad 1898, first printed in the yearbook Korsblomman 1899 (sv.wikipedia); later in Svensk söndagsskolsångbok 1929 (sv.wikisource). The title equals the first four words, so alt_words is used. Her own melody, so text-only public-domain status applies.

candidates.title: Giv mig ej glans, ej guld, ej prakt
candidates.first_line: Giv mig ej glans, ej guld, ej prakt
candidates.notes: Topelius born 14 Jan 1818, died 12 Mar 1898 (sv.wikipedia infobox). Sv.wikisource gives only 'Diktad 1887' and lists it in Psalmer, vol. 4 of Topelius' samlade skrifter (a posthumous collected edition), so the first printing date is NOT verified and must be checked before use. The first line is the title. The alt_words line is from the chorus of verse 1. Possibly a psalm/hymn: check for overlap with the hymn agent.

candidates.title: Nu så kommer julen, nu är julen här (Julvisa)
candidates.first_line: Nu så kommer julen, nu är julen här
candidates.notes: sv.wikipedia infobox: text by Topelius, published 1857; melody settings by Richard Norén (1875, Norén d. 1922) and Alice Tegnér (1895). Topelius death 1898 from the infobox. The first line is taken from the article title, not from a fetched verse, so the printed wording is NOT verified. The title contains the first five words, so a second verse line is needed for alt_words; none was fetched, so alt_words is null. Do not use until a verse is fetched.

candidates.title: Sankta Lucia, ljusklara hägring
candidates.notes: Lucia article (sv.wikipedia, Luciasången): 'Sankta Lucia, ljusklara hägring', by Sigrid Elmblad (1860-1926), published 1924. Elmblad's death year 1926 is from the sv.wikipedia infobox (born 28 May 1860, died 23 May 1926). The full first line as printed is NOT verified: no fetched source printed the verse, and the title shown here is only the opening phrase. words and alt_words are null until someone reads the verse text from a fetched source (a songbook or Svensk visarkiv). The melody is Neapolitan, which does not matter. The other Swedish Lucia text, 'Natten går tunga fjät' by Arvid Rosén, is rejected below.
